description: This file defines the BillingServiceCachingProxy class, which implements IBillingService and provides caching for billing data using Redis, as well as handling Stripe webhook events related to billing.

classes.name: BillingServiceCachingProxy
classes.description: A proxy class implementing IBillingService that adds Redis caching and Stripe event handling for billing operations.

methods.name: getBillingData
methods.description: Retrieves billing data, using cache if available.

methods.name: deleteBillingCache
methods.description: Deletes billing cache for a specific team.

methods.name: getBillingCache
methods.description: Retrieves billing cache for a specific team.

methods.name: setBillingCache
methods.description: Sets billing cache for a specific team.

methods.name: redirectToSubscribeCheckout
methods.description: Redirects to Stripe checkout for subscription.

methods.name: cancelTeamSubscription
methods.description: Cancels a team's subscription and clears cache.

methods.name: handleStripeSubscriptionDeleted
methods.description: Handles Stripe subscription deletion event and clears cache.

methods.name: handleStripePaymentSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful Stripe payment event and clears cache.

methods.name: handleStripePaymentFailed
methods.description: Handles failed Stripe payment event and clears cache.

methods.name: handleStripePaymentPastDue
methods.description: Handles Stripe payment past due event and clears cache.

methods.name: handleStripeCheckoutEvents
methods.description: Handles Stripe checkout session events and clears cache.

methods.name: handleStripeSubscriptionForActiveManagedUsers
methods.description: Handles Stripe events for active managed users.

methods.name: getSubscriptionIdFromInvoice
methods.description: Extracts subscription ID from Stripe invoice.

methods.name: getCustomerIdFromInvoice
methods.description: Extracts customer ID from Stripe invoice.
